name: Buried Stars
source:
"Nobody can wear two masks without revealing their true self."

It was the finals of the fourth season of "Buried Stars" a survival audition competition featuring public contestants.
The stage collapsed during the live broadcast, trapping the contestants and a number of the staff.

With hours to go until the arrival of a rescue team, their sponsored smartwatches are the only way to know what's going on in the outside world. By connecting to SNS via their smartwatches, they can see thousands of comments of worry, support, criticism and mockery. The survivors on the inside and the communicators on the outside wait for rescue.

Then an anonymous user on SNS forewarns of murder, saying that they must pay for their crimes, and the survivors become further divided as their predicament worsens...

Will the survivors be able to last until the rescue team arrives?
Who is the unknown killer, and why are they doing this?

What choice will the main character make at the end of this survival game?

[From the [url=https://buried-stars.com/]Original Website[/url]]
translation:
「沒有人能同時戴著兩副面具，卻始終不露出真面目。」

面向大眾參賽者的生存選秀節目「深埋之星」，迎來了第四季決賽。
直播期間，舞臺突然坍塌，參賽者與部分工作人員被困其中。

救援隊還要數小時才能抵達，贊助商提供的智慧手錶成了他們瞭解外界情況的唯一途徑。透過手錶連上社群網站，他們看到了成千上萬條擔憂、支援、批評與嘲諷的留言。被困的倖存者與外界透過網路同他們聯絡的人，都在等待救援。

這時，社群網站上的一位匿名使用者預告將發生命案，聲稱他們必須為自己的罪行付出代價。困境不斷惡化，倖存者之間的分歧也越來越深……

倖存者能撐到救援隊抵達嗎？
身分不明的兇手究竟是誰，又為何這麼做？

在這場生存遊戲的最後，主角會做出怎樣的選擇？
